literal: Love he does not have, since it is so, you suffering is foolishness; may you live, my heart!
translation: Since he has no love for us, your grieving for him is sheer foolishness, my heart! May you live long.
modern: அவர் நம்மிடம் அன்பு இல்லாதவராக இருக்க, என் நெஞ்சமே! நீ அவருக்காக வருந்துவது அறியாமையாகும்; நீ வாழ்க!
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine speaks to her own heart, which is deeply pining for her absent lover. She reasons that since he has shown no love by staying away, it is foolish for her heart to continue to suffer and ache for him. The phrase 'வாழி என் நெஞ்சு' (may you live, my heart) is a gentle, slightly ironic blessing used to address her own mind while pointing out its irrational behavior. The word 'பேதைமை' highlights the lack of wisdom in loving someone who does not return that love with equal intensity.
